mcp_tools.name: decision_ready_research_brief
mcp_tools.title: Decision ready research brief
mcp_tools.description: Submits a research-brief record (scope and questions, source strategy, declared sources, evidence notes, claims, synthesis, report structure, reuse and disclosure) and returns a deterministic RESEARCH_BRIEF_DECISION_READY / RESEARCH_BRIEF_NOT_DECISION_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across four sections, including computed source-provenance, claim-sourcing and triangulation-coverage checks, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared record; it performs no research and fetches nothing.

inputSchema.description: The research-brief manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and question/source/claim row schemas).

sources.description: Declared sources: {name, link, date, quote, source_type, incentives_noted}.

claims.description: Declared claims: {name, kind, material, important, supporting_source_names, confidence_stated}.

report_sections.description: Declared report section names, in order.

expect.notes: computed_spot_checks: questions_count=1, sources_count=2, claims_count=1, source_provenance_coverage=1.0000, material_claim_source_coverage=1.0000, important_claim_triangulation_coverage=1.0000
